name: OtpInput
description:
A one-time code in N boxes (Base UI OTP Field): autocomplete="one-time-code" so phones offer
the code from a message, a numeric keypad, paste fills every box (the code is found inside
"Your code is 482913"), Backspace steps back, the arrows move. Errors and success show on
the boxes themselves; nothing moves.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onComplete, length, characters, groups, autoSubmit, status, mask, size, disabled, readOnly, required, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: OtpInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Submit the surrounding form when complete (Base UI's autoSubmit). Default false.

props.name: characters
props.description: Digits (default) or letters and digits (recovery codes).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: groups
props.description: Split the boxes into groups with a gap: [3, 3] for six. Default: halves for 6 and 8.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of boxes. Default 6.

props.name: mask
props.description: Show dots instead of characters (a PIN). Default false.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the group of boxes, not when it moves between them.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once every box is filled (typed, pasted or autofilled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the code entered so far (upper case when alphanumeric) on each typed, deleted or
pasted character. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: status
props.description: error: the code was refused. success: accepted — boxes go green with a ✓, no shift either way.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
